title: tracking my skin across my menstrual cycle
description: tracking my skin across my menstrual cycle @Katetolo

segments.text: This device [music] scans your skin, and I did it every single day across my menstrual cycle. I put my face inside this derm, and it applies three different kinds of light: standard, cross-polarized, and UV light. Each scan measures eight parts of my skin. Across just one cycle, that's over 280 skin measurements. [music] Why am I doing this? Your skin literally runs on your hormones. Skin is affected by everything: sunlight, food, alcohol.

But, during this experiment, my diet, skin care, bedtimes, workout, and supplements all stayed the exact [music] same. So, if my skin changes, my hormones are the culprits. So, now we can ask things like, do my bacteria [music] inside my pores rise before acne becomes visible? Is it redness, texture, or pores? As far as we know, nobody has published daily hormone-verified multispectral imaging like this before.
My first full cycle is in data analysis now. Soon, we'll know exactly what happens to my skin across my menstrual cycle. Follow along for results.
